name: company.fit
description: Company-level fit for a $250K+ Head-of-AI / AI transformation seat: does this company pay at band, is AI a real mandate, and is this a place a builder-strategist would thrive. Input: company name, size, sector, any public signals.

pays_at_band.instructions: A company of this size, sector and funding stage typically pays $250K or more all-in for a VP/Head-of AI or senior director AI role

ai_mandate.instructions: How real the AI mandate is at this company
criteria: AI is a buzzword in the JD only
AI initiatives exist but no executive owner or budget named
Named executive sponsor and funded programs
AI is core to strategy with public commitments and a team already in place

risk_signals.instructions: Does the input ASSERT that layoffs, a hiring freeze, executive or leadership exits, missed numbers, or financial distress have happened or are happening in the last 12 months? Quote the asserting sentence first. A negated mention ('no layoffs'), a category discussed in analysis, a watch item, speculation about the future, and a planned, announced leadership succession with a named successor do NOT count. If the input only denies or analyses these categories, pick none_asserted.

criteria.none_asserted: The input does not assert that layoffs, hiring freeze, leadership turnover or financial distress occurred (denials and analysis do not count)
criteria.distress_asserted: The input asserts, cites or reports at least one of: layoffs, a hiring freeze, leadership turnover or executive exit, or financial distress

operator_fit.instructions: The environment rewards an operator who drives adoption across clinicians, plants or field teams, rather than a pure research or platform culture

rules.reason: company unlikely to pay at band
distress signals asserted in the input; check before investing
